title: Executive Summary of the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Serious Human Rights Violations in 1965–1966
authors: National Commission on Human Rights of Indonesia (Komnas HAM)
publisher_or_archive: Komisi Nasional Hak Asasi Manusia (Komnas HAM), Jakarta
summary: Official four-year judicial human rights inquiry by the Indonesian state human rights body concluding that the 1965–1966 massacres constituted gross human rights violations and crimes against humanity, including extermination, murder, enslavement, torture, and forced disappearances systematically conducted by military command structures.
